results.device_name: Filler, Bone Void, Recombinant Platelet-Derived Growth Factor
results.definition: For use as an alternative to autograft in hindfoot and ankle fusion procedures that require supplemental graft material, including tibiotalar, tibiocalcaneal, talonavicular and calcaneocuboid fusions.
